name: Chrysalis
source:
After waking up from a two-week coma, you’re greeted by Elise Medrano, your girlfriend of a year and a half. However, you don’t remember anything about her, nor about yourself. During the next few days, you relearn aspects of yourself and your relationship with her, but there’s some things that are still difficult to grasp...

[From [url=https://jeibon.itch.io/chrysalis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从两周的昏迷中醒来后，迎接你的是交往一年半的女友埃莉斯·梅德拉诺 (Elise Medrano)。然而，你不记得关于她的任何事情，也不记得关于你自己的任何事情。在接下来的几天里，你重新认识了自己的方方面面以及你和她的关系，但有些事情仍然难以理解……

[来自[url=https://jeibon.itch.io/chrysalis]Itch.io[/url]]
